# Mirek Umlauf — umlauf.tech

> Miroslav (Mirek) Umlauf is a Fractional Chief Data & AI Officer and Board Advisor based in Prague, Czech Republic. Twenty years delivering data and AI in global, complex environments: two IPOs (NYSE, then London), dozens of integrated acquisitions, former Chief Data Officer of a global consumer cybersecurity business.

## Who he is

- Fractional Chief Data & AI Officer and Board Advisor for companies that didn't grow up with large data teams
- Assistant Professor at FIS VŠE Prague (Prague University of Economics and Business) — Leadership in IT, Enterprise and Data Architecture, Lean Manufacturing and Data, Data-driven Decision-Making in Manufacturing
- Board Director (Sponsorships & Events), DAMA Czech Republic — data & AI governance community
- President, IMD Alumni Club Czech Republic & Slovakia
- Co-founder of Nuefis (managed data product services, nuefis.com) and LOLOLU; ventures in build in legal tech and board tech
- Mentor via Femme Palette; mentoring training at IMD and UC Berkeley

## What he does

Applies research to businesses: data and AI strategy that survives execution, non-invasive data governance, decision-intelligence systems for operations (including manufacturing and IoT), data collection design, and building internal data teams that outlast the engagement. Technology-critical: sizes technology to the real problem, avoids vendor lock-in the client didn't choose.
